basic_info.description: Tucked on a quiet little street just west of St. Mary's Playground, 5 College Terrace is where classic San Francisco charm meets a modern lifestyle and backyard vibes you won't want to leave. This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath single-family home is light-filled, warm, and stylish with hardwood floors and original details that give it just the right amount of warmth and character. The kitchen is updated and functional with stainless steel appliances and a sunny breakfast nook perfect for slow mornings. Upstairs, there are three comfortable bedrooms that share a spacious bathroom. Downstairs is your flex zone: A fourth bedroom with ensuite bathroom, 2-car garage, and  glass doors that open straight to your own private backyard escape. Soak in the hot tub, sip something tropical at the tiki bar, or just enjoy the peaceful patio surrounded by lush greenery it's a hidden retreat in the heart of San Francisco! All of this just minutes from parks, transit, cute cafes, and the 280. Three car parking included! Welcome to your next chapter in the Bernal Cut.
